facts.fact: Haydée Mercedes Sosa was born on July 9, 1935, in San Miguel de Tucumán, Tucumán, Argentina.
Mercedes Sosa was known as the 'voice of the voiceless ones' and was often referred to as 'the conscience of Latin America.'
Sosa passed away on October 4, 2009, from multiple organ failure in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
She was active as a singer and activist from 1950 until her death in 2009.
Sosa was a prominent exponent of 'nueva canción,' a music movement that combines folk music with political themes.

result.summary: Haydée Mercedes Sosa, born on July 9, 1935, in Argentina, was a celebrated singer and activist known as the 'voice of the voiceless ones.' She passed away on October 4, 2009, and was a key figure in the nueva canción movement.

Haydée Mercedes Sosa (9 July 1935 – 4 October 2009) was an Argentine singer who was popular throughout Latin America and many countries outside the region. With her roots in Argentine folk music, Sosa became one of the preeminent exponents of El nuevo cancionero. She gave voice to songs written by many Latin American songwriters. # Cantora, un Viaje Íntimo

Cantora, un Viaje Íntimo (English: Cantora, An Intimate Journey) is a double album by Argentine singer Mercedes Sosa, released on 2009 through Sony Music Argentina. The album features Cantora 1 and Cantora 2, the project is Sosa's final album before her death on October 4, 2009. [...] The double album was a commercial success, being certified platinum by the CAPIF selling more than 200,000 copies in Argentina, Cantora 1 was also certified platinum selling 40,000 copies while Cantora 2 was certified gold selling 20,000 copies. The album also peaked at numbers 22 and 8 at the Top Latin Albums and Latin Pop Albums charts in United States, respectively, being Sosa's only appearances on both charts.

At documentary film titled Mercedes Sosa, Cantora un viaje íntimo was released on 2009, it was directed by Rodrigo Vila and features the recording process of the album as well as testimonies from the different guest artists that appeared on the project.
